pairs.gold_text: Deaths were reported in connection with the Aldan House collapse by November 8.
Injuries were confirmed and documented in Nerridge during the collapse response.

unmatched_gold.text: Nerridge fire service reported rescuing people during the initial response to the Aldan House collapse.
PUSAR reported rescuing people on November 4 and again on November 6.

unmatched_system.text: Aldan House and east wing were destroyed.
Services were closed in Imber Street and Cobbett Row.

unmatched_gold.text: The collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing.
Later safety updates stated that the west wing had not collapsed.
The tower crane at the site was reported not to have fallen.
Later updates reported restoration of the tower crane in Imber Street and restoration of Aldan House.
Service at Aldan House was disrupted; later, services were reported closed along Imber Street and Cobbett Row.
About 85 people were reported displaced from Cobbett Row during the later phase of the response.

unmatched_system.text: People moved away from Cobbett Row because of displacement.

unmatched_gold.text: Dangerous conditions were reported at Cobbett Row while local services remained closed.
Assistance was provided in Cobbett Row during the later response.

pairs.gold_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed during the response and later reported rescuing people.
pairs.system_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue rescued people.

pairs.gold_text: Nerridge Police deployed in the city during the later phase of the response.

unmatched_system.text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue has deployed to assist with the situation.

unmatched_gold.text: Nerridge Police reported that no looting had been reported during the later response.

unmatched_system.text: Assistance was requested in Imber Street and Cobbett Row due to the building collapse.
Information was provided about the collapsed wing.
Transfer was completed in Cobbett Row.

pairs.gold_text: Requests for assistance were reported from Imber Street during the early phase of the emergency.
pairs.system_text: Help was requested for the affected areas in Nerridge.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Cobbett Row during the initial response to the collapse.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for Cobbett Row due to the building collapse.

unmatched_gold.text: Assistance was provided in Cobbett Row during the response.
